paragraphs: Aviat Networks, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, is a global supplier of microwave networking and wireless access networking solutions, backed by an extensive suite of professional services and support. Aviat Networks, Inc. may be referred to as "the Company," "AVNW," "Aviat Networks," "Aviat," "we," "us" and "our" in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.

Aviat was incorporated in Delaware in 2006 to combine the businesses of Harris Corporation's Microwave Communications Division ("MCD") and Stratex Networks, Inc. ("Stratex"). On January 28, 2010, we changed our corporate name from Harris Stratex Networks, Inc. to Aviat Networks, Inc.

Aviat's principal executive offices are located at 200C Parker Dr., Suite 100A, Austin, Texas 78728, and its telephone number is (512) 265-3680. Aviat's common stock is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the symbol AVNW. As of July 3, 2026, the Company had 900 employees.
We design, manufacture and sell a range of wireless transport and access networking products, solutions and services to two principal customer types.

1.Communications Service Providers ("CSPs"): These include mobile and fixed telecommunications network operators, broadband and internet service providers and network operators which generate revenues from the communications services that they provide.

2.Private network operators: These are customers which do not resell communications services but build networks for reasons of economics, autonomy, and/or security to support a wide variety of mission critical performance applications. Examples include federal, state and local government agencies, transportation agencies, energy and utility companies, public safety agencies and broadcast network operators around the world.
We sell products and services directly to our customers, and, to a lesser extent, agents and resellers.

Our products utilize microwave and millimeter wave technologies to create point to point and point to multi-point wireless links for short, medium and long-distance interconnections. In addition to our wireless products, we also provide routers and a range of premise and hosted private cloud-based software tools and applications to enable deployment, monitoring, network management, and optimization and operational assurance of our systems as well as to automate network design and procurement. We also source, qualify, supply, integrate, test and support third party equipment such as antennas, power supplies, optical transmission equipment and other equipment necessary to build and deploy a complete telecommunications transmission network. We provide a full suite of professional services for planning, deployment, operations, optimization and maintenance of our customers' networks.

Our wireless systems deliver urban, suburban, regional and country-wide communications links as the primary alternative to fiber optic, low earth orbit satellite and copper connections. Fiber optic connections are the primary connectivity alternative to wireless systems. In dense urban and suburban areas, wireless solutions can be faster to deploy and lower cost per mile than new fiber deployments. In developing nations, fiber infrastructure is often scarce and as a result wireless systems are used for both long and short distance connections. Wireless systems also have advantages over optical fiber in areas with rugged terrain, and to provide connections over bodies of water such as between islands or to offshore oil and gas production platforms. Through the air wireless transmission is also inherently lower in latency than transmission through optical cables and can be leveraged in time sensitive networking applications, such as high frequency trading. Our wireless access solutions provide cost-effective alternatives to provide connectivity to private network infrastructure, including smart cities, smart grid, distribution automation, metering and renewables, supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and telemetry, as well as vehicle and fleet connectivity.

Revenue from our North America and international regions represented approximately 50% and 50% of our revenue in fiscal 2026, 48% and 52% of our revenue in fiscal 2025, and 50% and 50% of our revenue in fiscal 2024, respectively. Information about our revenue attributable to our geographic regions is set forth in "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and in "Note 10. Segment and Geographic Information" of the accompanying consolidated financial statements and notes in this Annual Report on Form 10-K.
We believe that future demand for microwave and millimeter wave transmission systems will be influenced by a number of factors across several market segments.

As mobile networks evolve, expand, densify, add subscribers, and increase the number of wirelessly connected devices, sensors and machines, investment in backhaul infrastructure is required. Whether mobile network operators choose to self-build this backhaul infrastructure, or lease backhaul services from other network providers, we expect that the evolution of mobile networks will continue to drive demand for microwave and millimeter wave wireless backhaul transmission technologies. Within this overall scope, there are multiple individual drivers for investment in backhaul infrastructure.

•5G Deployments. Mobile Radio Access Network ("RAN") technologies are evolving. With the evolution from 4G (HSPA+ and LTE) to 5G, and now with 6G on the horizon, technology is rapidly advancing and providing subscribers with higher speed access to the Internet, social media, and video streaming services. The dramatic increase in data to be transported through the RAN and across the backhaul infrastructure drives requirements for higher data transport links necessitating upgrades to or replacement of the existing backhaul infrastructure.
•Subscriber Growth. Traffic on the backhaul infrastructure increases as the number of unique subscribers grows.

headings: Our success will depend on new products introduced to the marketplace in a timely manner, successfully completing product transitioning and achieving customer acceptance.
We must respond to rapid technological change and comply with evolving industry standards and requirements for our products to be successful.
Our development and use of AI and ML technologies, and their use by our competitors, customers, and threat actors, present operational, competitive, legal and reputational risks.
Our average sales prices may decline in the future.
Credit and commercial risks and exposures could increase if the financial condition of our customers declines.
Our restructuring actions could harm our relationships with our employees and impact our ability to recruit new employees.
Our business could be adversely affected if we are unable to attract and retain key personnel.
We face strong competition for maintaining and improving our position in the market, which can adversely affect our revenue growth and operating results.
Product performance problems, including undetected errors in our hardware or software, or deployment delays could harm our business and reputation.
If we fail to accurately forecast our manufacturing requirements or customer demand, we could incur additional costs, which would adversely affect our business and results of operations.
We depend on sole or limited sources and geographies for some key components and failure to receive timely delivery of any of these components could result in deferred or lost sales.
Because a significant amount of our revenue may come from a limited number of customers, the termination of any of these customer relationships may adversely affect our business.
Due to the volume of our international sales, we may be susceptible to a number of political, economic, financial and geographic risks that could harm our business.
We may not be able to obtain capital when desired on favorable terms, if at all, or without dilution to our stockholders.

paragraphs: The nature of the business activities conducted by the Company subjects us to certain hazards and risks. The following is a summary of some of the material risks relating to the Company's business activities. Other risks are described in "Item 1. Business," "Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" and "Item 7A. Quantitative and Qualitative Disclosures About Market Risk." Prospective and existing investors are strongly urged to carefully consider the various cautionary statements and risks set forth in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and in our other public filings.

We face many business risks, including those related to our financial performance, investments in our common stock, operating our business and legal matters. If any of these risks occur, our financial condition and results of operations could be materially and adversely affected. In that case, the market price of the Company's common stock could decline.
The following is a summary of the principal risks that could adversely affect our business, operations and financial results.

•Our sales cycle may be lengthy, and the timing of sales, along with additional services such as network design, installation and implementation of our products within our customers' networks, may extend over more than one period, which can make our operating results more volatile and difficult to predict and can complicate the proper recognition of revenue on more complex sales transactions.
•Our success will depend on new products introduced to the marketplace in a timely manner, successfully completing product transitioning and achieving customer acceptance.

•We rely on various third-party service partners to help complement our global operations, and failure to adequately manage these relationships could adversely impact our financial results and relationships with customers.

paragraphs: The following Management's Discussion and Analysis ("MD&A") is intended to help the reader understand Aviat Networks, Inc.'s ("Aviat", the "Company", "we", "us", or "our") results of operations and financial condition during the two-year period ended July 3, 2026. MD&A is provided as a supplement to, and should be read in conjunction with, the Company's consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes. In the discussion herein, the fiscal years ended July 3, 2026, June 27, 2025, and June 28, 2024, are referred to as "fiscal 2026", "fiscal 2025" and "fiscal 2024", respectively. Aviat's fiscal year ends on the Friday nearest to June 30. For a comparison of the results of operations for fiscal 2025 and 2024, refer to Aviat's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 27, 2025, filed with the SEC on September 10, 2025.

Aviat is a global supplier of microwave networking and access networking solutions, backed by an extensive suite of professional services and support. Aviat sells radios, routers, software and services integral to the functioning of data transport networks. Aviat has more than 3,000 customers and significant relationships with global service providers and private network operators. Aviat's North America manufacturing base consists of a combination of contract manufacturing and assembly and testing operated in Austin, Texas by Aviat. Additionally, Aviat utilizes a contract manufacturer based in Asia for much of its international equipment demand. Aviat's technology is underpinned by more than 300 patents. Aviat competes on the basis of Total Cost of Ownership ("TCO"), microwave radio expertise and solutions for mission critical communications.

On July 2, 2024, the Company acquired 4RF Limited ("4RF"), a New Zealand company, Aviat purchased all of the issued and outstanding shares of 4RF in an all-cash transaction for $18.2 million, net of $1.2 million cash acquired. 4RF is a leading provider of industrial wireless access solutions, including narrowband point-to-point/multi-point radios and Private LTE and 5G routers. The acquisition of 4RF allows Aviat to expand its product offering for the global industrial wireless access markets including Private LTE/5G. See Note 12. Acquisitions of the Notes to the consolidated financial statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (the "Notes") for further information.

On May 9, 2023, the Company entered into a Master Sale of Business Agreement (as amended on November 30, 2023, the "Purchase Agreement") with NEC Corporation ("NEC") to acquire NEC's wireless transport business (the "NEC Transaction"). The Company completed the NEC Transaction on November 30, 2023.

Prior to the acquisition date, NEC was a leader in wireless backhaul networks with an extensive installed base of their Pasolink series products. The completion of the NEC Transaction increases the scale of Aviat, enhances the Company's product portfolio with a greater capability to innovate, and creates a more diversified business. The results of operations of the NEC Transaction have been included in the consolidated financial statements since the date of acquisition.

The fair value of the consideration transferred at the closing of the NEC Transaction was comprised of (i) cash of $32.2 million, and (ii) the issuance of 736,750 shares or $22.3 million of common stock of the Company. The fair value of the shares issued was determined based on the closing market price of the Company's common stock on the acquisition date. Aggregate consideration transferred at closing was approximately $54.5 million, which was subject to certain post-closing adjustments. The Company funded the cash portion of the consideration with Term Loan borrowings under its Credit Facility. Refer to Note 7. Credit Facility and Debt of the Notes for further information.

In the second and fourth quarters of fiscal 2025, the Company transferred consideration of $5.8 million and $12.7 million, respectively, to settle the post-closing working capital adjustment. Refer to Note 12. Acquisitions of the Notes to the consolidated financial statements in this Annual Report on Form 10-K for further information.

The market for mobile backhaul continued to be the Company's primary addressable market segment globally in fiscal 2026. In North America, the Company supported 5G and long-term evolution ("LTE") deployments of its mobile operator customers, public safety network deployments for state and local governments, and private network implementations for utilities and other customers. In international markets, the Company's business continued to rely on a combination of customers increasing their capacity to handle subscriber growth and the ongoing build-out of some large LTE and 5G deployments. Aviat's position continues to be to support its customers for 5G and LTE readiness and ensure that its technology roadmap is well aligned with evolving market requirements. Aviat's strength in turnkey and after-sale support services is a differentiating factor that wins business for the Company and enables it to expand its business with existing customers. Additionally, Aviat operates an e-commerce on-line platform, Aviat Store, that provides low-cost services, a simple experience, and fast delivery to mobile operators and private network customers. Recently, U.S. tariffs on certain imported goods have increased costs within parts of the supply chain. Aviat has implemented mitigation measures, including sourcing and operational initiatives and pricing actions, to reduce the impact of these tariffs on its business and results of operations. However, as disclosed in the "Risk Factors" section in Item 1A of this Annual Report on Form 10-K, a number of factors could prevent the Company from achieving its objectives, including ongoing pricing pressures attributable to competition and macroeconomic conditions in the geographic markets that it serves.

The Company manages its sales activities primarily on a geographic basis in North America and three international geographic regions: (1) Africa and the Middle East, (2) Europe and (3) Latin America and Asia Pacific. Revenue by region for fiscal 2026 and 2025 and the related changes were as follows:
North America $ 220,034 $ 207,606 $ 12,428 6.0 % Africa and the Middle East 57,952 49,428 8,524 17.2 %

The Company achieved revenue growth of 1% in fiscal 2026 primarily driven by a 10% increase in software & licenses and 6% increase in equipment sales. This was partially offset by a 15% decrease in field services.
Revenue in North America increased by $12.4 million in fiscal 2026 primarily due to increases in software & licenses and field services, which increased 25% and 11%, respectively.

paragraphs: Aviat Networks, Inc., 連同其子公司，為全球提供微波網路與無線存取網路解決方案的供應商，並提供廣泛的專業服務與支援。Aviat Networks, Inc. 在本年度報告表 10-K 中可能被稱為 "the Company," "AVNW," "Aviat Networks," "Aviat," "we," "us" 和 "our"。
Aviat 於 2006 年在特拉華州成立，用以合併 Harris Corporation 的微波通訊部門（"MCD"）與 Stratex Networks, Inc.（"Stratex"）的業務。我們於 2010 年 1 月 28 日將公司名稱從 Harris Stratex Networks, Inc. 改為 Aviat Networks, Inc。
Aviat 的主要營業處所位於 200C Parker Dr., Suite 100A, Austin, Texas 78728，其電話號碼為 (512) 265-3680。Aviat 的普通股於 NASDAQ Global Select Market 上市，代號為 AVNW。截至 2026 年 7 月 3 日，本公司共有 900 名員工。
我們設計、製造並銷售一系列無線傳輸與存取網路產品、解決方案與服務，主要針對兩類主要客戶。
1. 電信服務提供者（"CSPs"）：這些包括行動與固定電信網路運營商、寬頻與網路服務提供者以及網路運營商，他們透過提供通訊服務來產生收入。
2. 私人網路運營商：這些是不轉售通訊服務，但為經濟效益、自主性與/或安全性而建立網路，以支援多種關鍵任務應用的客戶。範例包括聯邦、州與地方政府機構、交通機構、能源與公用事業公司、公共安全機構以及全球的廣播網路運營商。
我們直接向客戶銷售產品與服務，並在較小程度上透過代理商與經銷商銷售。

我們的產品使用微波與毫米波技術，以建立點對點與點對多點的無線連接，用於短、中、長距離的互聯。除了無線產品外，我們也提供路由器與一系列的門檻與雲端主機私有軟體工具與應用程式，以協助部署、監控、網路管理與優化及運營保障我們的系統，並自動化網路設計與採購。我們也取得、驗證、供應、整合、測試與支援第三方設備，例如天線、電源供應、光傳輸設備及其他必要的設備，以建立與部署完整的電信傳輸網路。我們提供完整的專業服務，用於客戶網路的規劃、部署、運作、優化與維護。

我們的無線系統提供都會、近郊、區域及全國範圍的通訊連線，作為光纖、低軌道衛星及銅線連線的主要替代方案。光纖連線是無線系統的主要連線替代方案。在人口密集的都會與近郊地區，無線解決方案可以比新興光纖部署更快部署且每英里成本更低。在發展中國家，光纖基礎設施通常稀少，因此無線系統被用於長距離與短距離連線。無線系統在地形崎嶇的地區，以及提供跨水域連線（例如島嶼之間或至離岸石油與天然氣生產平台）時，也比光纖有優勢。透過空氣的無線傳輸本質上延遲較低，比光纖電纜傳輸更適合時間敏感的網路應用，例如高頻交易。我們的無線存取解決方案提供成本效益的替代方案，用以提供私有網路基礎設施連線，包括智慧城市、智慧電網、配電自動化、計量與再生能源、監控控制與資料蒐集（SCADA）與遠測，以及車輛與車隊連線。

我們來自北美與國際地區的營業收入佔我們營業收入的約 50% 和 50%，在財務年度 2026 年為 48% 和 52%，在財務年度 2025 年為 50% 和 50%，在財務年度 2024 年為 50% 和 50%。關於我們來自地理區域的營業收入資訊，請參閱本年度 10-K 申報表所附的合併財務報表及附註中的「項目 7. 管理層對財務狀況與營運成果的討論與分析」以及「附註 10. 分部與地理資訊」。
我們認為未來對微波與毫米波傳輸系統的需求將受到多個因素影響，這些因素橫跨多個市場領域。
隨著行動網路的演進、擴張、密集化、增加用戶數與無線連線裝置、感測器與機械的數量，需要投資於回傳基礎設施。無論行動網路運營商選擇自建此回傳基礎設施，或租用其他網路供應商的回傳服務，我們預期行動網路的演進將持續推動對微波與毫米波無線回傳傳輸技術的需求。在這個整體範疇中，有多個個別因素驅動回傳基礎設施的投資。
•5G 部署。行動無線存取網路（"RAN"）技術正在演進。從 4G（HSPA+ 和 LTE）演進至 5G，現在 6G 已在地平線上，技術快速進步，為用戶提供更高的網際網路、社羣媒體與視訊串流服務存取速度。透過 RAN 與回傳基礎設施傳輸的資料量大幅增加，驅動對更高資料傳輸鏈路的需求，必須升級或更換現有的回傳基礎設施。
•用戶成長。回傳基礎設施上的流量隨著獨特用戶數量增加而增加。

paragraphs: 以下為管理層討論與分析（"MD&A"），旨在協助讀者瞭解 Aviat Networks, Inc.（"Aviat"、"本公司"、"我們"、"我們"或"我們"）在截至2026年7月3日兩年期間的營運成果與財務狀況。MD&A 作為補充資料，應與本公司合併財務報表及其附註一併閱讀。在本討論中，截至2026年7月3日、2025年6月27日及2024年6月28日的會計年度，分別稱為"會計2026年"、"會計2025年"及"會計2024年"。Aviat 的會計年度於接近6月30日的星期五結束。如需比較會計2025年與會計2024年的營運結果，請參閱 Aviat 於2025年9月10日向SEC提交的會計2025年年度報告（Form 10-K）。

Aviat 是一家全球性微波網路與存取網路解決方案供應商，背後有廣泛的專業服務與支援。Aviat 銷售無線電、路由器、軟體與服務，這些是資料傳輸網路運作所不可或缺的。Aviat 擁有超過3,000家客戶，並與全球電信業者與私人網路運營商有著重要的關係。Aviat 在北美地區的製造基地由位於德克薩斯州奧斯汀的委外製造與組裝測試組成。此外，Aviat 也利用位於亞洲的委外製造商來應對大部分國際設備需求。Aviat 的技術基於超過300項專利。Aviat 以總成本效益（"TCO"）、微波無線電專業知識與關鍵任務通訊解決方案進行競爭。

2024年7月2日，本公司取得4RF Limited（"4RF"），一家紐西蘭公司，Aviat 以現金交易方式購入4RF 全部發行在外的股權，總金額為18.2 百萬美元，扣除1.2 百萬美元現金取得。4RF 是工業無線存取解決方案的領導供應商，包括窄頻點對點/多點無線電與Private LTE 和5G 路由器。取得4RF 使Aviat 能夠擴展其在國際工業無線存取市場的產品組合，包括Private LTE/5G。詳情請參閱本年度報告（Form 10-K）附註12。取得資產的附註。
2023年5月9日，本公司與NEC Corporation（"NEC"）簽訂一份主業務出售協議（後經2023年11月30日修正，稱為"購買協議"），以取得NEC 的無線傳輸業務（"NEC 交易"）。本公司於2023年11月30日完成NEC 交易。
在取得日之前，NEC 是無線回傳網路的領導者，擁有廣泛的產品安裝基礎。完成NEC 交易後，Aviat 的規模增加，並強化了本公司產品組合的創新能力，同時也使業務更加多元化。自取得日開始，NEC 交易的營運結果已納入合併財務報表。
NEC 交易在交易完成時的公平價值由以下組成：(i) 現金32.2 百萬美元，以及(ii) 發行736,750 股本公司普通股，價值22.3 百萬美元。發行股票的公平價值係根據取得日本公司普通股的收盤市價決定。交易完成時的總對價約為54.5 百萬美元，並受某些交易後調整條款所影響。本公司以信用貸款借款來資助現金部分的對價。詳情請參閱本年度報告（Form 10-K）附註7。信用貸款與債務附註。
在會計2025年的第二及第四季，本公司分別支付5.8 百萬美元與12.7 百萬美元的對價，以解決交易後的營運資金調整。詳情請參閱本年度報告（Form 10-K）附註12。取得資產的附註。

在會計2026年，移動回傳市場仍是本公司在全球的主要可接觸市場。在北美地區，本公司支援其移動電信客戶的5G與長期演進（"LTE"）部署、地方政府與地方政府的公共安全網路部署，以及電力公司及其他客戶的私人網路實作。在國際市場，本公司業務依賴於客戶增加容量以處理用戶成長，以及一些大型LTE與5G部署的持續建設。Aviat 的立場持續支援客戶的5G與LTE準備，並確保其技術路線圖與市場需求的變化保持一致。Aviat 在整體解決方案與售後支援服務方面的優勢，是本公司獲取業務的差異化因素，並使其能與現有客戶擴展業務。此外，Aviat 運作一個電子商務線上平台Aviat Store，為電信業者與私人網路客戶提供低成本服務、簡易體驗與快速交貨。最近，美國對某些進口商品的關稅已提高部分供應鏈的成本。Aviat 已實施緩衝措施，包括採購與運營方案及價格調整，以減少這些關稅對其業務與營運成果的影響。然而，如本年度報告（Form 10-K）第1A項"風險因素"部分所披露，許多因素可能使本公司無法達成其目標，包括來自競爭與本公司服務地理市場的總體經濟條件的持續價格壓力。
本公司主要以地理區域為基礎管理銷售業務，於北美及三個國際地理區域進行：(1) 非洲及中東、(2) 歐洲及(3) 拉丁美洲及亞太地區。2026 財年及 2025 財年各區域的營業收入及相關變動如下：
本公司在 2026 財年實現 1% 的營業收入成長，主要驅動因素為軟體及授權增加 10% 以及設備銷售增加 6%。此部分被場外服務減少 15% 所抵銷。
北美地區的營業收入在 2026 財年增加 12.4 百萬美元，主要由於軟體及授權增加以及場外服務增加，分別增加 25% 及 11%。

headings: 財務與總體經濟風險因素
本公司之成功將取決於能否及時推出新產品至市場、順利完成產品過渡並獲得客戶接受度。
我們必須回應快速的技術變革，並符合產業標準及規範，以確保產品之成功。
本公司開發及應用人工智能（AI）與機器學習（ML）技術，以及競爭對手、客戶及威脅者使用這些技術，可能帶來運營、競爭、法律及聲譽風險。
我公司的平均銷售價格未來可能下降。
若客戶財務狀況惡化，我們的信用及商業風險與 exposures 可能增加。
我們的重整行動可能損害與員工的關係，並影響我們招募新員工的能力。
若我們無法吸引並留住關鍵人員，業務可能受到不利影響。
我們面臨強烈競爭，以維持並改善在市場中的地位，這可能不利於我們的營收成長與營運結果。
產品性能問題，包括未察覺的硬體或軟體錯誤，或部署延誤，可能損害我們的業務與聲譽。
若我們無法準確預測製造需求或客戶需求，我們可能產生額外成本，這將對我們的業務與營運結果造成不利影響。
我們依賴某些關鍵零組件的獨家或有限來源與地理區域，若無法及時取得任何這些零組件，可能導致延後或喪失銷售。
因為我們的營業收入可能來自有限數量的客戶，任何這些客戶關係的終止可能會對我們的業務產生不利影響。
由於我們國際銷售的規模，我們可能面臨多種政治、經濟、財務及地理風險，這些風險可能對我們的業務造成損害。
我們可能無法在有利的條件下，或在任何情況下取得所需資金，或必須對股東的股票進行稀釋。
全球或市場特定的影響
paragraphs: 本公司所從事之業務活動具有某些風險與危害。以下為與本公司業務活動相關之重大風險摘要。其他風險請參閱「第 1 項 業務」、「第 7 項 管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之分析」及「第 7A 項 市場風險之量化與質化揭露」。預期及現有投資人應謹慎考量本年度 10-K 報告及本公司其他公開申報文件中所列之各項警示聲明與風險。
我們面臨許多業務風險，包括與我們財務表現、投資本公司普通股、營運業務及法律事務相關之風險。若任何風險發生，將可能對我們之財務狀況與營運結果造成重大且不利之影響。在此情況下，本公司普通股之市場價格可能下跌。
以下為可能對我們業務、營運及財務結果造成不利影響之主要風險摘要。
• 我們之銷售週期可能較長，銷售時間與附加服務如網路設計、安裝及在客戶網路中實施我們產品之時間，可能跨越多個會計期間，這將使我們之營運結果更為波動且難以預測，並可能使複雜銷售交易中之收入認列變得更加困難。
• 我們之成功將取決於能否及時推出新產品至市場、順利完成產品過渡並取得客戶接受度。
• 我們依賴多種第三方服務夥伴協助補強全球營運，若未能妥善管理這些關係，將可能對我們之財務結果與客戶關係造成不利影響。
